evidencePolicy.bytecode: UI.PVEInfo.pveSweep / UI.PveSweepEnd.pveSweep → rpc_s_pve_sweep({level}); ClientPlayer.rpc_c_pvesweep_result / rpc_c_pvesweep_fail / rpc_c_refresh_sweepinfo; Comp.PVESweepManager stamina only
evidencePolicy.inferred: Drop rates are user-authorized local policy; green_pro used as ordinary book rate when present

callChain.pre: Client may useTili and/or ResourceManager.useRes before the RPC

localAdapter.exp: Always grant data.pve_stage.sweep_hero_exp to heroes with state===1
localAdapter.ordinaryDrop: From stage 7; rate = green_pro if set else 1/3; retain the original combined ordinary pool and denominator, but grant only skill-book selections. Knowledge-book selections in this branch grant nothing, preserving each skill-book marginal probability (usually 17.5%).
localAdapter.knowledgeBookDrop: Independent 0.33 per eligible sweep, selecting one 210000 entry from the stage repeat-event chain; currently 1 book per hit. Only stages that already contain the book qualify. Can coexist with skill and rare rewards.
localAdapter.rareDrop: Independent roll at rareRate 0.08 among non-ordinary chain items (e.g. crystal)
localAdapter.period: Consume period_control[period_num_limit]; exhausted counter treated as client-paid reset then one use
localAdapter.persist: Package/exp/counters/tili written before UI; inputAward/addRes stubbed during rpc_c_pvesweep_result to avoid double grant
